lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in at least five identifiable vertical columns posterior to the branchial region. Each column contains between 3 and 5 local intensity maxima.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a regular grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the visible mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible running across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient where pixel luminance decreases significantly below the ridge line.

other_distinctive_markers: A group of approximately 8 to 10 elongated, low-intensity silhouettes is clustered in the water column immediately ventral to the pectoral fin and posterior midsection.
